title: How Absorbing a Cost You Didn't Cause Trains a Godly Man to Lead
caption:
Every man who's ever actually led you paid for something first. Not with a title. With a cost he didn't have to take.

He took the hit before he assigned the blame. Covered the mistake in front of the group and corrected it alone, later. Stayed the extra hour nobody was tracking.

And he didn't mention what it cost him. The moment you mention it, it stops being a gift and starts being a bill.

Christ didn't lead from a ledger of what was fair to Him. Neither should you.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #servanthood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
